# Governance Data Health

This workbook reports ingestion freshness and silence. `UnavailableOrSilent` can mean absent, unlicensed, unauthorized, disabled, or simply no events. Validate each source in its native portal and connector configuration.

content.query:
M365Gov_DataHealth(24h)
| project TableName, Status, LastEventTime, Age, EventCount, ExpectedFreshness, RequiredForMvp, AuthoritativeControlOwner, NativePortalRoute
| order by RequiredForMvp desc, Status asc, TableName asc
content.title: Freshness and remediation routing
